languageHint: Applies to the whole app. Changing it reloads the window.
macNoBadge: macOS doesn't let harbard put the number on the Dock icon.
macNotificationsOff: macOS has harbard's notifications turned off: you won't see the number in the Dock or any notifications.
couldNotSaveDesktop: Couldn't save in the desktop app.
reduceMotionOsOn: macOS already has “Reduce motion” on, so nothing moves.
reduceMotionHint: For the robots, their reactions and the logo. If macOS has “Reduce motion” on, they don't move either.
dimStripHint: From 22:00 to 7:00, if macOS is in dark mode.
enterThemeName: Enter a name: letters, numbers and hyphens.
couldNotCopy: Couldn't copy; the code is in the field below.
themesUnavailable: harbard isn't responding; themes can't be changed right now.
modeHint: Any theme works in light and dark.
themesHint: Frame, sidebar and accent. Hover to preview, click to choose.
customThemeHint: Pick two colors; harbard derives the rest and checks that everything is readable.
name: Name
seasonHint: Automatic dresses harbard for {name} from {from} to {to}, by your local date. Your chosen theme stays chosen.
seasonDecorationsHint: Snow over the frame, lights along the top and a small visitor in the Lobby. With Reduce motion they stand still.
systemAlertsHint: A notification when an agent hands you work, alerts you or the connection is lost. Same as “Mute” in the menu bar.
systemAlertsDesktopOnly: Desktop app only: harbard doesn't show system notifications in the browser.
dndHint: Pauses the Dock bounce, system notifications and icon flashes. What needs you still reaches Needs you and the Dock number.
dndDefaultHint: The one marked in your avatar menu.
hourlyDigest: Also get a digest every hour
hourlyDigestHint: In Focused and Swamped, agent messages that aren't blocking are held and reach you together when you leave the state. With this on, every 60 minutes too.
awaySuggest: Suggest Away when I step away from the Mac
awaySuggestHint: After 10 minutes without touching the Mac, or with the screen locked, the desktop app offers to set you to Away, and to Available when you're back. It never changes your state unless you press it.
soundHint: harbard never makes a sound: system notifications always arrive silently.
dockAttentionHint: When something new needs you and harbard isn't in the foreground, its icon bounces once in the Dock. Desktop app only.
pageAppearanceHint: Light or dark, the theme, the season's and your own.
pageGeneralHint: Language, motion, the strip at night and where saved rules go.
pageNotificationsHint: When harbard calls you, and when it leaves you alone.
pageTeamsHint: The Macs that share this harbard and what each may do.
pageUpdatesHint: Which changes count as a new version, and where harbard updates from.
stripWhat: A wide view of your agents, made for a 2560 × 720 display such as a bar monitor under the main screen.
stripWide: The app found that display when it started and opened the Strip there on its own, without a frame.
stripWindow: No 2560 × 720 display was connected when the app started, so the Strip waits as an ordinary window: open it here, with ⌘2, or from the menu.
stripNone: The app could not open the Strip this time.
stripBrowser: The Strip is part of the desktop app.
